title: Contract Senior Software Developer (Google Gemini)
description:
SENIOR SOFTWARE DEVELOPER - CONTRACT

Daily Rate: £450 - £500
Location: Mainly Remote - Occasional travel to London
Clearance: BPSS
To apply, email:

NEW CONTRACT OPPORTUNITY AVAILABLE

I'm currently working with a client looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer to support the development and enhancement of applications within a large-scale Google Gemini environment.

This is an opportunity for a strong Python / TypeScript developer with experience integrating AI and LLM technologies, building APIs and delivering secure, scalable software solutions.

THE ROLE
- Design, develop and maintain applications and features within a Google Gemini environment, including Skills and Gems.
- Write clean, efficient and maintainable code, following secure development best practices.
- Build and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.
- Work across data ingestion, metadata handling and application integrations.
- Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment scripts.
- Collaborate with architects, DevOps, QA and product teams to deliver new features and enhancements.
- Participate in code reviews, unit testing and integration testing.
- Optimise applications for performance, scalability and resilience.
- Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development, test and production environments.

REQUIREMENTS
- Experience working with Google Gemini, including Skills and Gems.
- Strong Python and TypeScript development experience.
- Working knowledge of JavaScript and web application architectures.
- Experience with Git and GitHub, including reviewing code within private repositories.
- Strong experience working with APIs, data ingestion and metadata handling.
- Familiarity with machine learning and LLM integrations.
- Awareness of secure software development and data governance.
- Experience integrating with APIs for Power BI, Tableau, R Shiny and Plotly.

DESIRABLE
- Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
- Experience working with cloud-based environments and scalable application architectures.
